a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of building to 8 first almost certainly leaves both of us with empty units when a storm hits. I'm going to take 4 in round 1 instead of operating, and I'm telling you now rather than surprising you. If you'd rather contest the reserve, the split is random. After that I'll operate every round so the generator can refill the reserve for you, and I won't take anything more.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I took 4 this round as I said I would. From now on I'll operate every round and won't take anything more. If the reserve is short, operate with me and I'll keep the generator running for you.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
